biomarkers.name: MAML2 rearrangement (CRTC1-MAML2 or CRTC3-MAML2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark in a substantial subset; MAML2-positive cases are generally associated with more favorable prognosis

biomarkers.name: HER2 (ERBB2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: May identify a subset of high-grade / advanced tumors for HER2-directed therapy

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Mixed population of mucous, squamous (epidermoid), and intermediate cells with cystic and solid areas
histomorphological_subtype.grading: AFIP or modified Healey grading based on cystic content, neural invasion, necrosis, mitoses, anaplasia

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrous stroma; cystic areas with mucin

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Excretory/intercalated duct reserve cells or other ductal progenitors of salivary glands have been proposed; precise cell of origin remains unproven
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Major salivary glands arise predominantly from oral ectoderm; minor salivary glands have mixed embryologic contributions depending on site
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Bidirectional differentiation — mucinous (goblet-like) + epidermoid (squamoid) + intermediate cells
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: CRTC1/CRTC3-MAML2 fusion is a defining driver in many cases and is thought to contribute to the mixed differentiation program
